speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Domestically, Singaporeans desire greater diversity in perspectives and engagements in policy formulation.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will have to not only deliver higher quality and more integrated public services, but also to engage Singaporeans more thoroughly in the formulation and execution of policies.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We have to leverage advancements in Science and Technology (S&T) to overcome the constraints of manpower and financial resources.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We are building stronger common competencies across our Public Service that are needed by all agencies.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: In addition, we will tighten our focus on solving problems beyond agency boundaries.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: This will mean that cross-agency teams will become more common, as we take the right people with the right experiences and skills to develop policies and programmes that address national challenges to meet our people's needs.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Our Public Service must work with citizens, businesses and other stakeholders differently.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will conduct early and close consultations to understand their needs, hear their ideas, and work with them to design programmes.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will also need to work with and through them to implement programmes together for greatest impact.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Our Public Service will recruit and develop its people differently.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will recruit candidates from diverse backgrounds so that we have a Public Service workforce that can bring different perspectives to problems and contribute different skills to create new solutions to problems.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: As our environment changes very fast, we will invest more in skills upgrading to enable our officers to stay employable over a longer career.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will rotate officers to different jobs, so that they gain a wider perspective, and get more opportunities to work with partners in the people and private sectors.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: This will keep them close to the ground, and give them a diverse body of networks, skills and experiences to solve problems effectively.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Our Public Service will transform the way it works and its people, but our values of Integrity, Service and Excellence will never change.
